corporate.title: Know a company that could sponsor a class of 15?
corporate.body: Volunteers are often the first link to a new corporate partner — a quick introduction goes a long way.

experience.q: Do I need experience to volunteer?
experience.a: No. Most of our volunteers have never worked with neurodiverse members before their first shift. Coaches brief you on-site, every time.

cancel.q: What if I need to cancel a shift?
cancel.a: Life happens — cancel or swap through the member app up to 24 hours ahead, no penalty. We'd just ask you not to no-show, since a role sitting empty means a class runs short-staffed.

training.a: Yes. Every new volunteer gets a short on-site briefing before their first shift, plus a returning volunteer paired alongside them for support.

group.q: Can I bring a friend, or volunteer as a group?
group.a: Absolutely — group and friend sign-ups are common, especially for the community dinners & trips crew and corporate days.

csrOnePager.title: Corporate Volunteer Day at Love 21 Foundation
csrOnePager.intro: Share this with your HR or CSR team — everything they need to say yes is on this page.
csrOnePager.whatIsBody: A hands-on day at our San Po Kong centre alongside our members — no experience needed. Past teams have helped run sports sessions, nutrition workshops, and community events.
